question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution is related to the Right to Freedom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 19.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​**Article 19:-**

 
 
• The Right to Freedom is enshrined in Article 19 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 19 guarantees six freedoms to the citizens of India, namely, freedom of speech and expression, freedom of assembly, freedom
